verdict.rationale: Workable's own feature page documents one-submission multiposting to 200+ job boards, which covers the core fan-out part of the story. Nothing in the pack shows sponsored or paid post management from inside the ATS, and LinkedIn and Indeed are never named. missing for 10: sponsored/paid post management (budgets, promotion) inside the ATS, explicit confirmation of LinkedIn/Indeed/aggregator coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, one posting fans out to the job boards — LinkedIn, Indeed, and the aggregators — with sponsored-post management from inside the ATS

citations.quote: Post your job to 200+ job boards simultaneously, reaching a wider audience with a single submission.
